correctness.rationale: For each fixed strictly convex m-gon m>=3 and fixed w_i>0, on the event every edge is hit, the exact hull deficit is the sum of corner wedge areas d_i R_{i-1} L_i. Disjoint adjacent boundary subintervals give joint tail (1-w_{i-1}s-w_i t)^n, whose integral yields F_n; the missing-edge event is bounded by sum(1-w_j)^n. All 2m rescaled edge endpoint gaps tend jointly to independent exponentials and have uniform all-order moments, establishing n^2 deficit convergence, mean C=sum_i d_i/(w_{i-1}w_i), and variance 3 sum_i [d_i/(w_{i-1}w_i)]^2. Positive Hessian of 1/(xy) gives strict convexity of C on positive simplex and unique optimum; KKT says equal weights iff adjacent d sums constant, with parity and parallelogram consequences. Independent rational integration and convex-hull/rectangle checks corroborated the normalization, including 357/800 for n=3 and neighboring interval probabilities 1/5,3/10.
